headline: PS5 Disc Drive Purchase Cap limits buyers to one unit since March 2025
summary: Sony limits PS5 disc drive purchases to one per customer. The cap has been in place since at least March 2025.
details: The PS5 disc drive purchase cap has been in effect since at least March 2025, according to Tom's Hardware. This limit is due to 'high demand'.
The cap restricts customers to buying only one PS5 disc drive per purchase. No further details have been provided on the duration of this limit.
Sony has not made an official statement on the reason behind this cap, but it is likely related to managing supply and demand for the popular gaming console.

headline: Uber pauses European expansion in 5 markets
summary: Uber pauses launches in Austria, Norway, Greece and 2 more
details: Uber announced in February plans to launch in seven new European markets in 2026. However, the company has now paused launches in five of those markets, including Austria, Norway, and Greece.

The decision to pause further expansion may be linked to Uber's efforts to acquire Delivery Hero, a European company that operates delivery services in several of the target countries. A potential acquisition could alleviate antitrust concerns.
Uber confirmed recent launches in Finland and Denmark had been a 'huge success', and now wants to 'focus on continuing the momentum' in existing markets.
caption:
Uber hits brakes on European expansion. What happened?
